aj: Heads-up: saw a spike where requests for tenant `foo` fell back to the small-quant model even though the dedicated pool showed some headroom. Need clarity on selection order.
leo: Can you paste the gateway logs or the route decision output?
aj: Pasting snippet: `route=tenant/foo -> matched /v1/generate -> affinity=tenant:foo -> chosen=model-a -> fallback=model-b-small`
ops-bot: Circuit-breaker tripped: tenant=foo threshold=95% cpu, window=30s, cb_state=OPEN
jen: My hunch: quota-surge tokens were exhausted and the router preferred cost-safe fallback rather than honoring reserved capacity keys.
irene: Current priority is confusing: affinity header -> capacity ticket -> CB state -> cost score. That order explains this behavior.
sam: Proposal: reorder to affinity -> CB -> capacity -> cost. CB should preempt capacity checks to avoid oscillation when transient overloads occur.
leo: Concern: putting CB before capacity could surface more cold starts on dedicated pools during flapping CBs. Suggest a soft-grace window for CB transitions (e.g., 10s).
aj: Also we need debugging response headers for on-call: `X-RI-Fallback-Chain`, `X-RI-Model-Family`, `X-RI-CB-Reason`. Makes triage so much faster.
jen: Security note: do not expose internal model IDs by default. Expose model family or cost-tier behind an admin flag.
irene: Telemetry request: add metric `fallback.selection.count` with labels {tenant, selected_family, cb_triggered, route_origin} and a histogram `fallback.latency_delta_ms` for observed extra latency compared to primary route.
sam: :thumbsup: I'll draft the CB-first proposal doc and add examples showing tradeoffs.
leo: Also would be really helpful if the Console rollout view could simulate "would-fallback-to" for a canary config so PMs can see the hypothetical chain.
aj: Action items: 1) add headers (family-only, feature-flagged) - @jen; 2) CB-first proposal doc - @sam; 3) metrics + histogram - @irene; 4) console simulation view - @leo. I'll open tickets and link here.
ops-bot: Tickets created: #INF-4923 (fallback-metrics), #INF-4924 (cb-priority-proposal), #INF-4925 (console-fallback-sim)
jen: small ask: add `X-RI-Route-Reason` with a short code (e.g., `CB_OPEN`, `NO_CAPACITY`, `PRICED_OUT`) so logs can be grouped without exposing internals.
aj: Perfect — that'll make the alert rules much cleaner. I'll schedule a quick sync to align owners.
